accepted.meaning: Retain the earlier bounded actual-end-state erosion policy. In the third-base/one-out strikeout plus passed-ball score example, TFS is -1/4. The runner's advance receives no batter progress credit.

Run Construction Breadth includes each distinct offensive player whose supported contribution advanced the scoring runner, including that runner's own batting and independent running. Own single plus steal followed by a teammate's scoring double has breadth two.
Initially count Batter Role, Baserunner Role, Pitcher Role and Fielder Role when actually realized by the player in the game. Do not count generic parent roles again.
